children: Hong Kong telecom operator's fiscal yr revenue grew 6%, driven by handset and accessory sales
Net income attributable to shareholders rose 10% yr/yr
Board recommended final dividend, maintaining full-year payout at 32 HK cents per share
Company expects Hong Kong mobile market to remain highly competitive in the near future
SmarTone aims to reverse declining service revenue and halt erosion in ARPU
Company plans further investment in network to support digitization and AI
HANDSET AND ACCESSORY SALES - Revenue growth was primarily driven by higher handset and accessory sales
COST CONTROL - Staff costs and other operating expenses were reduced by 8% and 4% year-on-year, respectively, due to cost control and operational efficiency measures
SERVICE REVENUE DECLINE - Total service revenue declined by 3% and ARPU for postpaid mobile business fell, reflecting competitive pressures
